descriptionHtml:
HIKVISION E100 256GB 2.5" SATA SSD Specifications


Capacity: 256GB


Form Factor: 2.5-inch


Interface: SATA III 6 Gb/s (Backward compatible with SATA II 3 Gb/s)


Flash Technology: 3D TLC (Triple-Level Cell) NAND Flash


Sequential Read Speed: Up to 550 MB/s


Sequential Write Speed: Up to 450 MB/s


MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures): 1,500,000 hours


Shock Resistance: 1500g/0.5ms


Operating Temperature: 0°C to 70°C (32°F to 158°F)


Dimensions: 100.1 mm × 69.9 mm × 7.0 mm


Features:


S.M.A.R.T. support


TRIM command support


Wear leveling for longer
